html:
Reflecting Upon International Nurses Week

Reflecting on last week being International Nurses, we at Goodwill Staffing and Recruiting would like to talk about the positivity that nurses bring to a patient’s every need.

Several people visit the hospitals for unfortunate reasons. Whether that be from an accident, illness, or surgery.

Nurses everywhere provide the utmost attention, care, and warmth patients need during their stay.

Nurses stationed in retirement homes, long-term care homes, clinics, hospitals, and other care homes, dedicate an immense amount of time to providing care in the long term.

We think back to situations where families had to be admitted and were surrounded by loved and close ones. The nurses always made sure everyone around was taken care of just as much as the patients.

Nurses everywhere are tremendously hardworking, loving, and sacrifice a lot in their roles. They have taken that choice to dedicate their lives to the medical field.

Many nurses have also inspired others to take on nursing and long-term care roles because of how rewarding and impactful such a role is.

Nurses do not only serve their patients, they serve and impact the community at large.

We at Goodwill Staffing and Recruitment would like to celebrate all nurses, care staff, and first responders globally. We see you, we acknowledge you and we thank you for all you do!
